findings.title: No picture of a boat or the canal in the hero

location.description: the whole hero, which has only text, a list and the form

findings.viewer_experience: People buy this as a holiday and want to see the boat and the water before they book, but the headline has to carry the whole idea alone. The space under the form on desktop and widescreen is empty.
findings.target: one real photograph of the company's own boats or canal in the hero, supplied by the maker
findings.fix_direction: Set one real photograph of the company's own boats or canal into the hero. The maker must supply it, because a stock shot does not do the same job.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees one real photograph of a boat or the canal in the hero in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports

findings.title: The tablet text column is too narrow, so the route names wrap and the headline breaks into four lines

location.description: the headline in the narrow left column on the tablet

findings.viewer_experience: The route list reads ragged, and the headline breaks into short lines of about 9 characters. The right column has about 430 px of empty space under the form.

current.value: left column 268 px wide; h1 on 4 lines

findings.target: route names on one line and the h1 on two or three lines
findings.fix_direction: Let the hero text column take more width, or stack the page below about 800 px.

closed_when.check: lines of h1 in the tablet viewport is 3 or fewer, and each route-name span in the tablet viewport has 1 line

findings.title: On the phone, Search sits below the first screen, after the route list

location.description: the Search button at the bottom of the form on the phone

findings.viewer_experience: A visitor must scroll past the routes to book.

current.value: Search button at about 1019 px, on a first screen of 844 px

findings.fix_direction: Put the form before the route list, or directly under the lead.

closed_when.check: the top of the button box in the phone viewport is lower than the 844 px screen height by less than it is now, with the form before the route list

findings.title: The lock count in the route details has no explanation for a hirer

location.description: the route detail "7 nights, 38 locks" in the first route row

findings.viewer_experience: A first-time hirer does not know what 38 locks means for the work or the time of the trip.

current.value: 7 nights, 38 locks, with nothing that says what the count means

findings.target: the route details say what the lock count means for a hirer, in words the company supplies
findings.fix_direction: Say what the lock count means for a hirer. Only the company can supply that fact, so the maker must supply it.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees text near the lock count in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports that says what it means for a hirer

findings.title: There are still five type sizes

location.description: the type scale across the page: 44, 24, 18, 16 and 14 px

findings.viewer_experience: The scale reads a little looser than it needs to.
findings.target: a tighter scale, with the logo size or the 14 px labels joining a nearby step
findings.fix_direction: If the logo size or the 14 px labels joined a nearby step, the scale would be tighter.

closed_when.check: type_sizes in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports lists 4 or fewer sizes
